public.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
public.description: A nonempty strictly increasing array of distinct integers was rotated by any number of positions, including zero. Return its smallest value. Length is 1 to 1000; integers are between -10000 and 10000.
hints: Compare the middle value with the right endpoint.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: The minimum remains inside the selected half, including the middle when it is no larger than the right endpoint. O(log n) time and O(1) space.
